critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the existing window row geometry along the fuselage to create two distinct rows. Offset the new upper row by 15% of the total fuselage height from the original, and apply a 20% reduction in length to the forward section to define the 'hump' area. Adjust the spacing parameter so that windows are omitted or clustered around door locations to maintain realistic cabin proportions.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck).

discrepancies.observed: Windows are missing or merged into the main fuselage line.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct, shorter row of windows on the forward 'hump' section.

discrepancies.observed: No visible door frames or outlines on the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular outlines for main cabin and service doors.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length.
